issue_context.title: [BUG] TestCase.location incorrect/different when merging reports
issue_context.body:
<!-- ⚠️⚠️ Do not delete this template ⚠️⚠️ -->

<!-- 🔎 Search existing issues to avoid creating duplicates. -->
<!-- 🧪 Test using the latest Playwright release to see if your issue has already been fixed -->
<!-- 💡 Provide enough information for us to be able to reproduce your issue locally -->

### System info
- Playwright Version: 1.39.0
- Operating System: macOS 14.1
- Browser: Chromium
- Other info:

### Source code

- [x] I provided exact source code that allows reproducing the issue locally.

<!-- For simple cases, please provide a self-contained test file along with the config file -->
<!-- For larger cases, you can provide a GitHub repo you created for this issue -->
<!-- If we can not reproduce the problem locally, we won't be able to act on it -->
<!-- You can still file without the exact code and we will try to help, but if we can't repro, it will be closed -->

**Config file**

```js
// playwright.config.ts
import { defineConfig, devices } from '@playwright/test';

export default defineConfig({
  testDir: './specs',
  projects: [
    {
      name: 'chromium',
      use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'], },
    },
  ]
});
```

**Test file (self-contained)**

```js
it('Run test', async ({ page }) => {
  // Do nothing
});
```

**Test reporter**
```ts
class CustomReporter implements Reporter {
	onTestEnd( test: TestCase, result: TestResult ) {
		console.log( 'onTestEnd', test.location.file);
	}
}
```

**Steps**

My project is in `/full/path/to/my/project` and specs are in `/full/path/to/my/project/specs`

- Run tests with `--reporter path/to/custom-reporter.ts`
- Get console output such as `onTestEnd /full/path/to/my/project/specs/frontend.spec.ts`
- Run tests with `--shard=1/2 --reporter=blob` followed by `npx playwright merge-reports --reporter path/to/custom-reporter.ts ./blob-report`
- Get console output such as `onTestEnd /full/path/to/my/project/frontend.spec.ts`

**Expected**

I'd expect `test.location.file` to be the same when running tests normally and when merging reports.

**Actual**

The `/specs` path segment is missing when merging reports
comments:
Currently, blob reports preserves test name relative to `config.testsDir` and when you created report for `/full/path/to/my/project/specs/foo/frontend.spec.ts` and later cal `merge-reports` in `/merge/dir/cwd`, the test path will be resolved relative to that directory to`/merge/dir/cwd/foo/frontend.spec.ts`.

Can you please clarify, what is your expectation regarding the location in such scenario?

Ah, that's good to know! Is that documented somewhere and I just missed it?

It's definitely counter-intuitive as the test path won't be a relative path but a "made up" path that doesn't actually exist.

I expected the file location to not change and to be the actual location of the file on disk, if that makes sense.

The rationale for resolving it when running `merge-rerports` command is that it may be running in a completely different directory and the original directory with the tests may not even exist on that machine, also original paths won't make sense when merging on an OS different from where blob report was produced.

In that case, instead of preserving the path relative to `config.testsDir` to come up with `/merge/dir/cwd/foo/frontend.spec.ts` (which won't exist), maybe it could use the file name itself, i.e. `frontend.spec`? Not sure if what's less confusing though.

Anyhow, your explanation is valuable already and I can work around this either way.

review_comments: Should we update our docs to suggest a config when merging between OSes?
